prayers.name: High Expectations
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **^^Brodd’s Stomp^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of the chanter. If the chanting roll was 9+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic instead.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Brodd's Stomp Priest^^** to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
